$room..write: auth != null && !data.exists() && newData.child('meta/host').val() == auth.uid && newData.child('meta/phase').val() == 'lobby' && newData.child('slots/0').val() == auth.uid && newData.child('members').hasChild(auth.uid)

meta..write: auth != null && (data.child('host').val() == auth.uid || (data.child('leaseUntil').val() < now && newData.child('host').val() == auth.uid && root.child('minikSplash/rooms').child($room).child('members').child(auth.uid).child('connected').val() == true && newData.child('epoch').val() == data.child('epoch').val()+1 && newData.child('phase').val() == data.child('phase').val() && newData.child('seed').val() == data.child('seed').val() && newData.child('round').val() == data.child('round').val()))
meta..validate: newData.hasChildren(['host','phase','mode','topic','seed','leaseUntil','epoch','round']) && newData.child('host').isString() && (newData.child('phase').val() == 'lobby' || newData.child('phase').val() == 'playing' || newData.child('phase').val() == 'finished') && newData.child('leaseUntil').isNumber() && newData.child('leaseUntil').val() <= now + 12000 && newData.child('epoch').isNumber() && newData.child('round').val() >= 1 && newData.child('round').val() <= 5 && (!newData.hasChild('maxPlayers') || (newData.child('maxPlayers').isNumber() && (newData.child('maxPlayers').val() == 2 || newData.child('maxPlayers').val() == 3 || newData.child('maxPlayers').val() == 4 || newData.child('maxPlayers').val() == 5 || newData.child('maxPlayers').val() == 6) && (newData.child('mode').val() != 'TEAMS' || newData.child('maxPlayers').val() == 4 || newData.child('maxPlayers').val() == 6)))

$uid..write: auth != null && $uid == auth.uid && ((!data.exists() && root.child('minikSplash/rooms').child($room).child('meta/starting').val() != true && root.child('minikSplash/rooms').child($room).child('meta/phase').val() == 'lobby' && newData.child('bot').val() == false) || (data.exists() && newData.child('id').val() == data.child('id').val() && newData.child('character').val() == data.child('character').val() && newData.child('team').val() == data.child('team').val() && newData.child('bot').val() == data.child('bot').val()))
$uid..validate: newData.hasChildren(['id','character','team','bot','name','ready','connected']) && newData.child('id').val() == $uid && newData.child('bot').isBoolean() && newData.child('ready').isBoolean() && newData.child('connected').isBoolean() && newData.child('name').isString() && newData.child('name').val().length <= 40 && (newData.child('team').val() == 0 || newData.child('team').val() == 1) && (newData.child('character').val() == 'miniko' || newData.child('character').val() == 'minik' || newData.child('character').val() == 'kyra' || newData.child('character').val() == 'flare' || newData.child('character').val() == 'gaya' || newData.child('character').val() == 'mia' || newData.child('character').val() == 'amber' || newData.child('character').val() == 'comet' || newData.child('character').val() == 'june' || newData.child('character').val() == 'moshiko' || newData.child('character').val() == 'coach67') && newData.child('slot').isString() && newData.parent().parent().child('slots').child(newData.child('slot').val()).val() == $uid

settings..validate: newData.hasChildren(['walk','throwing','arena','court','balloons','subjects']) && (newData.child('walk').val() == 'EASY' || newData.child('walk').val() == 'STANDARD') && (newData.child('throwing').val() == 'EASY' || newData.child('throwing').val() == 'STANDARD') && (newData.child('arena').val() == 'BEACH' || newData.child('arena').val() == 'PARK' || newData.child('arena').val() == 'ANDROMEDA') && newData.child('court').isBoolean() && (newData.child('balloons').val() == 'ONE_PLACE' || newData.child('balloons').val() == 'ALL_OVER')

$event..validate: newData.hasChild('type') && newData.child('at').isNumber() && newData.child('at').val() >= now-30000 && newData.child('at').val() <= now+5000 && !newData.hasChild('score') && ((newData.child('type').val() == 'move' || newData.child('type').val() == 'aim') && newData.child('x').isNumber() && newData.child('x').val() >= -100 && newData.child('x').val() <= 100 && newData.child('y').isNumber() && newData.child('y').val() >= -100 && newData.child('y').val() <= 100 || newData.child('type').val() == 'pickup' && newData.child('qid').isString() && newData.child('qid').val().length < 120 && newData.child('index').val() >= 0 && newData.child('index').val() <= 3 || newData.child('type').val() == 'throw' || newData.child('type').val() == 'jump' || newData.child('type').val() == 'crouch' || newData.child('type').val() == 'hint' || newData.child('type').val() == 'walkTo' && newData.child('x').isNumber() && newData.child('x').val() >= -32 && newData.child('x').val() <= 32 && newData.child('y').isNumber() && newData.child('y').val() >= -32 && newData.child('y').val() <= 32 && newData.child('index').isNumber() && newData.child('index').val() >= -1 && newData.child('index').val() <= 3 && newData.child('qid').isString() && newData.child('qid').val().length < 120 || newData.child('type').val() == 'shootAt' && newData.child('target').isString() && root.child('minikSplash/rooms').child($room).child('members').hasChild(newData.child('target').val()))

$slot..write: auth != null && root.child('minikSplash/rooms').child($room).child('meta/phase').val() == 'lobby' && ((!data.exists() && newData.val() == auth.uid && root.child('minikSplash/rooms').child($room).child('meta/starting').val() != true) || root.child('minikSplash/rooms').child($room).child('meta/host').val() == auth.uid)
